arguments.name: tags
arguments.description: (Optional) Map of tags to assign to the resource. If configured with a provider [`defaultTags` configuration block](https://registry.terraform.io/providers/hashicorp/aws/latest/docs#default_tags-configuration-block) present, tags with matching keys will overwrite those defined at the provider-level.

arguments.name: virtualizationType
arguments.description: (Optional) Keyword to choose what virtualization mode created instances will use. Can be either "paravirtual" (the default) or "hvm". The choice of virtualization type changes the set of further arguments that are required, as described below.

arguments.name: rootDeviceName
arguments.description: (Optional) Name of the root device (for example, `/dev/sda1`, or `/dev/xvda`).

arguments.name: bootMode
arguments.description: (Optional) Boot mode of the AMI. For more information, see [Boot modes](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/ami-boot.html) in the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud User Guide.

arguments.name: deprecationTime
arguments.description: (Optional) Date and time to deprecate the AMI. If you specified a value for seconds, Amazon EC2 rounds the seconds to the nearest minute. Valid values: [RFC3339 time string](https://tools.ietf.org/html/rfc3339#section-5.8) (`YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SSZ`)

arguments.name: kernelId
arguments.description: (Required) ID of the kernel image (AKI) that will be used as the paravirtual kernel in created instances.

arguments.name: enaSupport
arguments.description: (Optional) Whether enhanced networking with ENA is enabled. Defaults to `false`.

arguments.name: imageLocation
arguments.description: (Required) Path to an S3 object containing an image manifest, e.g., created by the `ec2-upload-bundle` command in the EC2 command line tools.

arguments.name: imdsSupport
arguments.description: (Optional) If EC2 instances started from this image should require the use of the Instance Metadata Service V2 (IMDSv2), set this argument to `v2.0`. For more information, see [Configure instance metadata options for new instances](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/configuring-IMDS-new-instances.html#configure-IMDS-new-instances-ami-configuration).

arguments.name: ramdiskId
arguments.description: (Optional) ID of an initrd image (ARI) that will be used when booting the created instances.

arguments.name: architecture
arguments.description: (Optional) Machine architecture for created instances. Defaults to "x86_64".

arguments.name: name
arguments.description: (Required) Region-unique name for the AMI.

arguments.name: sriovNetSupport
arguments.description: (Optional) When set to "simple" (the default), enables enhanced networking for created instances. No other value is supported at this time.

arguments.name: description
arguments.description: (Optional) Longer, human-readable description for the AMI.

arguments.name: tpmSupport
arguments.description: (Optional) If the image is configured for NitroTPM support, the value is `v2.0`. For more information, see [NitroTPM](https://docs.aws.amazon.com/AWSEC2/latest/UserGuide/nitrotpm.html) in the Amazon Elastic Compute Cloud User Guide.

arguments.name: uefiData
arguments.description: (Optional) Base64 representation of the non-volatile UEFI variable store.

arguments.name: ebsBlockDevice
arguments.description: (Optional) Nested block describing an EBS block device that should be attached to created instances. The structure of this block is described below.

arguments.name: ephemeralBlockDevice
arguments.description: (Optional) Nested block describing an ephemeral block device that should be attached to created instances. The structure of this block is described below.

arguments.name: snapshotId
arguments.description: (Optional) ID of an EBS snapshot that will be used to initialize the created EBS volumes. If set, the `volumeSize` attribute must be at least as large as the referenced snapshot.

arguments.name: volumeType
arguments.description: (Optional) Type of EBS volume to create. Can be `standard`, `gp2`, `gp3`, `io1`, `io2`, `sc1` or `st1` (Default: `standard`).

arguments.name: deleteOnTermination
arguments.description: (Optional) Boolean controlling whether the EBS volumes created to support each created instance will be deleted once that instance is terminated.

arguments.name: deviceName
arguments.description: (Required) Path at which the device is exposed to created instances.

arguments.name: encrypted
arguments.description: (Optional) Boolean controlling whether the created EBS volumes will be encrypted. Can't be used with `snapshotId`.

arguments.name: outpostArn
arguments.description: (Optional) ARN of the Outpost on which the snapshot is stored.

arguments.name: throughput
arguments.description: (Optional) Throughput that the EBS volume supports, in MiB/s. Only valid for `volumeType` of `gp3`.

arguments.name: volumeSize
arguments.description: (Required unless `snapshotId` is set) Size of created volumes in GiB.

arguments.name: iops
arguments.description: (Required only when `volumeType` is `io1` or `io2`) Number of I/O operations per second the created volumes will support.

arguments.name: deviceName
arguments.description: (Required) Path at which the device is exposed to created instances.

arguments.name: virtualName
arguments.description: (Required) Name for the ephemeral device, of the form "ephemeralN" where *N* is a volume number starting from zero.

arguments.name: create
arguments.description: (Default `40m`)

arguments.name: delete
arguments.description: (Default `90m`)

arguments.name: update
arguments.description: (Default `40m`)
